name: wellsure-hr-portal
description: Wellsure HR Portal — root convenience scripts only. backend/, frontend/, biometric-agent/ and infra/ are each standalone npm projects with their own package.json and package-lock.json.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix biometric-agent && npm install --prefix infra
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix biometric-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix biometric-agent && npm run typecheck --prefix infra
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix biometric-agent
